derived_competitive_set._derivation_method: Derived from the PRODUCT CATEGORY (Fast food: quick counter-service meal), not the owner's list. Price spread in this category: wide at the item level (S$3.03-35.02), converged at the meal level (S$5 floor). Tiers follow the eight-tier frame: default/no-purchase, cheap substitute, direct set, category incumbent (the rungs of the customer's mental ladder), adjacent crossover, indirect, and new entrants derived from public opening records.
